feat.name: Eagle Knight Dedication
feat.access: You're invited by a current member of the Eagle Knights or the People's Council.
entries: Eagle Knights are the marshals and envoys of Andoran and are committed to keeping the peace. On the first round of combat, if you roll {@skill Diplomacy|PC1} for initiative, creatures that haven't acted are {@condition off-guard|PC1} to you. You gain the {@feat Additional Lore|PC1} skill feat for {@skill Lore|PC1|Politics Lore}. If you were already trained in {@skill Lore|PC1|Politics Lore}, you also become trained in a {@skill Lore|PC1} skill of your choice. You can use {@skill Lore|PC1|Politics Lore} to {@action Make an Impression|PC1} on or make a {@action Request|PC1} of government officials (or similar figures) or to {@action Gather Information|PC1} about them. If you critically succeed at a check to {@action Gather Information|PC1} with {@skill Lore|PC1|Politics Lore}, you know the information without having to spend any time gathering it.

feat.name: Commitment to Equality
feat.prerequisites: {@feat Eagle Knight Dedication|LOSK}, expert in {@skill Diplomacy|PC1}
entries: You help an ally shake off any impediment that would give an enemy an unfair advantage. You rally a creature within 30 feet in an attempt to reduce its {@condition frightened|PC1} or {@condition stupefied|PC1} condition. If a creature has multiple conditions from this list, choose one. When you're a master in {@skill Diplomacy|PC1}, add {@condition clumsy|PC1} and {@condition enfeebled|PC1} to the list of conditions. When you're legendary in {@skill Diplomacy|PC1}, add {@condition stunned|PC1} to the list of conditions; if the {@condition stunned|PC1} condition has a duration instead of a value, you can't use Commitment to Equality to reduce it.

Attempt a {@skill Diplomacy|PC1} check against the saving throw DC of the effect that caused the condition; if there was no saving throw DC, use the hard DC for the level of the creature, hazard, or item that caused the effect. You can't treat a condition that came from an artifact or effect above 20th level unless you're legendary in {@skill Diplomacy|PC1}; even if you can, the counteract DC increases by 10.

You can't treat a condition that is part of a curse or disease or is a natural state of the target. Once you attempt to treat a target's condition, that target is immune to further attempts for 1 hour, regardless of the result.

feat.name: Interpose
entries: You put yourself between an ally and danger. {@action Stride|PC1} up to your Speed. You must end your movement adjacent to an ally. You and your ally then swap positions with each other. After changing positions, you can make a melee {@action Strike|PC1} against an enemy within your reach.

feat.name: Commitment to Justice
feat.requirements: You witnessed a creature kill or reduce an ally to 0 Hit Points since your last turn.
entries: When your allies are harmed, you deliver retribution. Make a {@action Strike|PC1} against the required creature. If this {@action Strike|PC1} hits, you gain a circumstance bonus to damage equal to three times the number of weapon damage dice.

feat.name: Commitment to Liberty
feat.requirements: A creature has an ally {@condition grabbed|PC1} or {@condition restrained|PC1}.
entries: You can't abide when a foe has one of your allies in its grip. Make a {@action Strike|PC1} against the required creature. If this {@action Strike|PC1} hits, the {@condition grabbed|PC1} or {@condition restrained|PC1} ally can immediately attempt to {@action Escape|PC1} as a free action. If the {@action Strike|PC1} was a critical hit, that ally gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their {@action Escape|PC1} attempt.

feat.name: Bolster Ally
feat.trigger: One of your allies within 30 feet is targeted by a spell or ability that allows a saving throw.
entries: You shout encouragement to your embattled ally. The ally can use your saving throw modifier instead of their own against the triggering spell.

feat.name: Stir Allies
entries: You shout a command for your allies to scramble. Allies within 30 feet can use a reaction to {@action Step|PC1}. If you're legendary in {@skill Diplomacy|PC1}, they can instead {@action Stride|PC1}.

feat.name: Aura of Confidence
entries: Your will and your faith in your nation is unassailable, and the feeling is contagious. You gain resistance to mental damage equal to half your level. You and all allies within 15 feet gain a +2 status bonus to saving throws against {@trait mental} effects.

feat.name: Talmandor's Shout
feat.prerequisites: {@feat Eagle Knight Dedication|LOSK}, master in {@skill Intimidation|PC1}
feat.requirements: You witnessed a creature deal damage to an ally within 30 feet since your last turn.
entries: After seeing an enemy harm one of your allies, you deliver a righteous shout in the name of the celestial Talmandor. Attempt an {@skill Intimidation|PC1} check to {@action Demoralize|PC1}, comparing the result to the Will DC of each enemy within a 60-foot emanation; this {@action Demoralize|PC1} attempt doesn't take any penalty for not sharing a language. It's possible to get a different degree of success for each target.

feat.name: Even the Odds
entries: Even when overpowered, Eagle Knights hold out hope. If your next action is to use {@feat Commitment to Equality|LOSK}, you roll the {@skill Diplomacy|PC1} check twice and take the higher result. If you succeed, the target also gains 25 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute.

feat.name: Immediate Rebuke
entries: You can use {@action Reactive Strike|PC1} when a creature within your reach {@action Strike|PC1|Strikes} one of your allies.

feat.name: Inflame Crowd
entries: Your performances are a call to action for the crowds who listen to you. For 1 hour after you successfully {@action Make an Impression} using {@skill Performance|PC1}, you can make a {@action Request|PC1} of a member of the affected audience using {@skill Performance|PC1} instead of {@skill Diplomacy|PC1}.

feat.name: Stifle Flames
entries: Your forestry experience helped you develop techniques for fighting wildfires. Any time you attempt a skill check to extinguish a non-magical fire, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the check. Your DC on flat checks to end {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent fire damage} is reduced from 15 to 10, or from 10 to 5 after receiving especially appropriate assistance.

feat.name: Vanish into the Land
feat.prerequisites: master in {@skill Stealth|PC1}, trained in {@skill Survival|PC1}, {@feat Terrain Stalker|PC1}
entries: You're adept at using the land's natural features to find places to hide. When in the difficult terrain you've selected for the {@feat Terrain Stalker|PC1} feat, you can {@action Hide|PC1} and {@action Sneak|PC1} even without cover or being {@condition concealed|PC1}.

feat.name: Prophet of Kalistrade Dedication
feat.prerequisites: trained in {@skill Lore|PC1|Mercantile Lore} and {@skill Society|PC1}, Charisma +2
entries: After induction into the ranks of the Kalistocrats, you learned the skills necessary to succeed in business and rise above others by following a set of detailed strictures. Unless you take measures to hide your affiliation, anyone who has heard of the Prophets of Kalistrade will know you're one of them when they see you.

You become an expert in {@skill Society|PC1} and can use {@skill Society|PC1} instead of {@skill Diplomacy|PC1} to {@action Make an Impression|PC1} on merchants and traders. Additionally, if you don't already cast spells from spell slots, you learn to cast spontaneous spells and gain the Cast a Spell activity. You gain a spell repertoire with two {@trait common} {@trait occult} cantrips, plus either {@spell prestidigitation|PC1} or {@spell read aura|PC1}. You're trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for these spells is Charisma, and they're {@trait occult} spells.

feat.name: Basic Prophet Spellcasting
entries: You gain the basic spellcasting benefits. Each time you gain a spell slot of a new rank from the {@archetype prophet of Kalistrade|LOSK} archetype, add a common {@trait occult} spell of the appropriate rank, or another appropriate {@trait occult} spell you've learned or discovered, to your repertoire.

feat.name: Smile at Failure
entries: You know staying cool is key to prevailing in social situations, as anger leads to mistakes. When a creature you're interacting with decreases its attitude from {@condition indifferent|PC1} to {@condition unfriendly|PC1} or from {@condition unfriendly|PC1} to {@condition hostile|PC1}, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to any attempts to {@action Make an Impression|PC1} on the creature for the next hour. If this decrease in attitude leads to combat, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the subsequent initiative roll instead.

feat.name: Fortune's Favor
feat.trigger: You're about to reroll a failed skill check or saving throw due to a {@trait fortune} effect.
entries: You understand when an investment in you has the chance to pay off. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to the triggering roll.

feat.name: Prolific Prophet Spellcasting
entries: Increase the number of spells in your repertoire and the number of spell slots you gain from {@archetype prophet of Kalistrade|LOSK} archetype feats by 1 for each spell rank other than your two highest prophet of Kalistrade spell slots.

feat.name: Prophet's Lockbox
entries: You've learned secret methods that allow you to store your valuables where no one else can reach them. You can cast {@spell imaginary lockbox|PC2} as a 5th-rank innate {@trait occult} spell once per day. At 12th level and every 2 levels thereafter, the maximum amount you can target with this spell increases by 1 Bulk.

feat.name: Expert Prophet Spellcasting
feat.prerequisites: {@feat Basic Prophet Spellcasting|LOSK}, master in {@skill Society|PC1}
entries: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits.

feat.name: Master Merchant
entries: Kalistrade teaches that setbacks are only temporary and that perseverance is a treasured virtue. When you fail, but not critically fail, at a {@skill Society|PC1} or {@skill Lore|PC1|Mercantile Lore} check to {@action Earn Income|PC1} at a specific task and are allowed to continue working at that task on subsequent days, you can choose to attempt the skill check again the next day. If you succeed, you get a critical success and continue to earn that amount on further days spent working at the task, if the task lasts that long.

feat.name: Master Prophet Spellcasting
feat.prerequisites: {@feat Expert Prophet Spellcasting|LOSK}, legendary in {@skill Society|PC1}
entries: You gain the master spellcasting benefits.

feat.name: Blackjacket Dedication
feat.prerequisites: trained in medium armor and martial weapons
entries: You have entered the ranks of the Mercenary League and now wear the black uniform that's the source of the organization's popular epithet. You become trained in {@skill Intimidation|PC1}; if you were already trained, you become an expert instead. You gain the {@feat Additional Lore|PC1} skill feat for {@skill Lore|PC1|Warfare Lore}; if you were already trained in {@skill Lore|PC1|Warfare Lore}, you also become trained in a {@skill Lore|PC1} skill of your choice. While wearing medium or heavy armor, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to {@skill Intimidation|PC1} checks.

feat.name: Belay That!
feat.trigger: An ally within 30 feet of you critically fails a {@action Strike|PC1}.
entries: You can recognize when a strategy isn't working and advise your ally to change course. The next {@action Strike|PC1} the triggering ally makes before the end of their turn has the same multiple attack penalty as the critically failed {@action Strike|PC1}, but it counts toward their multiple attack penalty as normal.

feat.name: Mercenary Motivation
entries: A large part of being in the Mercenary League entails doing mercenary work. You spend 1 minute planning a course of action that will allow you to complete a task you've been hired or requested to do. Work with your GM to determine the circumstances of any job or task if need be, but typically, they can involve protecting a place or person, defeating a foe or enemy force, or retrieving an item. The course of action you plan must be something you believe you can accomplish.

{@b Active Plan} You can have only one course of action planned at a time. If you use Mercenary Motivation to plan a second course of action, you no longer receive the bonus to checks related to the first course of action.

{@b On the Job} Whenever you attempt a {@skill Perception|PC1} check or skill check that will advance your course of action, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the check. The exact checks this bonus applies to depend on your current job and are determined by the GM.

{@b Finishing a Plan} When you complete the course of action you planned to do, you don't lose the bonus or other benefits until you make a different plan with Mercenary Motivation or voluntarily {@action Dismiss|PC1} the current plan.

feat.name: Battlefield Agility
feat.requirements: You're flanked by at least two enemies.
entries: Your enemies might think they have you surrounded, but you know just how to extricate yourself. Make a melee {@action Strike|PC1} against one of the enemies flanking you and {@action Step|PC1}, in any order.

feat.name: Lead by Example
entries: You telegraph your next attack to let your allies in on your strategy. Make a melee or ranged {@action Strike|PC1} with a −2 circumstance penalty. On a hit, the next ally to target the same creature with a {@action Strike|PC1} gains a +2 circumstance bonus to their attack roll. On a critical hit, the bonus applies to any allies who act before the start of your next turn.

feat.name: Nothing Personal
feat.requirements: You have an active course of action planned.
entries: When you're on a job, you can't allow anyone to stop you. Designate a single creature you can see as being an impediment to your active course of action. The first time you {@action Strike|PC1} your impediment in a round, you deal an extra die of weapon damage. At 14th level, this increases to two extra dice, and at 20th level, this increases to three extra dice.

You can have only one creature designated as an impediment at a time. If you use Nothing Personal against a creature when you already have a creature designated, the prior creature loses the designation, and the new impediment gains the designation. Otherwise, your designation lasts for 1 hour.

feat.name: Close Contract
feat.requirements: You have completed your active course of action but haven't {@action Dismiss|PC1|Dismissed} it or chosen a new one.
entries: You're bolstered when a plan comes together. You {@action Dismiss|PC1} your current course of action and gain 15 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 hour. The number of temporary Hit Points increases by 5 at 12th level and every 2 levels thereafter.

feat.name: Opportune Opening
feat.trigger: An ally lands a critical hit on a creature within your melee reach.
entries: Your combat training taught you to capitalize on any moment of weakness from your foe. You make a melee {@action Strike|PC1} against the same creature your ally just hit. The creature is {@condition off-guard|PC1} against this {@action Strike|PC1}.

feat.name: Stalwart Song
feat.trigger: You're about to attempt a saving throw against a {@trait fear} effect.
entries: As a stalwart defender, you rely on your martial training and your tried-and-true armor to face any danger without flinching. Your mountain-like resilience and courage draw strength from the centuries-old traditions of dwarven song. You bring to mind—and possibly give voice to—a cherished dwarven song of inspiring heroism, granting you a +2 circumstance bonus to the saving throw.

feat.name: Stalwart Chant
entries: You know story after story of unyielding, valiant dwarven heroes whose minds were bulwarks against fear and confusion. You can use Stalwart Song when attempting a saving throw Five Kings Mountains Options against any {@trait mental} effect, and if you fail the saving throw, you gain resistance to mental damage against any resulting effect equal to half your level.

feat.name: Headless Haunt
feat.access: You were executed with a {@item final blade|LOWG}.
entries: You were condemned to death and executed with one of Galt's infamous {@item final blades|LOWG}, where your soul was trapped for years or even decades. You might have been released alongside a host of other spirits when your prison was destroyed after the Night of the Gray Death, or powerful magic or other unique circumstances might have facilitated your escape. Whatever the method, you have unfinished business preventing you from passing on to the afterlife. You gain the Remove Head action.

entries.name: Remove Head
entries: You {@action Interact|PC1} to remove your head from your ghostly body and hold it in a free hand. While your head is detached, you can use it to look around and over obstacles while remaining behind cover, although you don't have line of effect to target creatures unless the effect originates from your head. You can leave your head behind and move your body around independently, but your head gains the {@condition paralyzed|PC1} condition and your body becomes {@condition blinded|PC1|blind}, {@condition deafened|PC1|deaf}, and unable to take any action that has the {@trait auditory} trait that requires speech or vocalization. You can cause your head to dematerialize and reappear atop your neck as a free action, which occurs automatically if it takes damage while detached or is separated from your body by more than 50 feet.

feat.name: Fling Head
entries: You {@action Interact|PC1} to remove your head, if it isn't already detached, and fling it at an enemy within 30 feet, where it emits a bone-chilling wail before dematerializing and returning to your body. Your target must attempt a Will save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. You can affect one additional creature within 20 feet of your original target for each additional action you spend.

Failure: The creature is {@condition frightened|PC1|frightened 2} and can't reduce their {@condition frightened|PC1} value below 1 while they remain within 30 feet of you.
Critical Failure: As failure, but the creature is {@condition frightened|PC1|frightened 3}.

feat.name: Haunting Memories
entries: Your soul bears metaphysical impressions of the innumerable other spirits imprisoned with you in the final blade from which you escaped, allowing you to draw upon their memories. When you make your daily preparations, you can either gain the expert proficiency rank in one skill in which you're untrained or raise your proficiency rank to master in one skill in which you're trained or better. You also gain one skill feat with a minimum requirement of your new rank in the chosen skill. For the purpose of meeting level prerequisites for this feat, your level is equal to half your level.
This proficiency and feat last until you make your daily preparations again. Since the proficiency is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for any permanent character option.

feat.name: Klingegeist
entries: Your imprisonment inside a final blade used to perform countless executions has instilled in you an aptitude for entering and possessing similar sharp implements of murder. You project your mind and incorporeal body into an unattended weapon of 2 Bulk or less that deals slashing damage.

While possessing a blade, you have a space of 5 feet, but you don't block or impede enemies attempting to move through your space, nor do you benefit from or provide flanking. You're trained in the use of the weapon, unless your proficiency was already better, and you can make {@action Strike|PC1} actions with the weapon as if you were wielding it. You gain a {@action Fly|PC1} speed of 30 feet and can only take {@action Strike|PC1} and {@action Fly|PC1} actions, which don't trigger reactions. You have an AC of 18 + your level and the Hardness and Hit Points of the weapon you're possessing, which for most one-handed slashing weapons is Hardness 5 and HP 20. You can't be {@action Disarm|PC1|Disarmed}, nor can your true body be directly injured except by spirit damage, which bypasses both the weapon's Hardness and Hit Points to damage you directly.

If you're reduced to 0 Hit Points or the weapon you're inhabiting is {@condition broken|PC1} or destroyed, you're immediately ejected from it and {@condition paralyzed|PC1} for 1 round. Otherwise, the effect lasts for 10 minutes or until you {@action Dismiss|PC1} it.

feat.name: Ghostly Condemnation
entries: You shriek a death sentence upon a single target within 120 feet, forcing it to experience the final moments of your mortal life as you were dragged through a howling mob and forced to kneel before the final blade that took your life and head. The target is subject to the effects of a 5th-rank {@spell vision of death|PC1} with a DC equal to your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. If you slay a significant foe with this ability, its physical body is gruesomely decapitated, forcing its allies within 15 feet to attempt a Will save against the same DC or be {@condition frightened|PC1|frightened 1} ({@condition frightened|PC1|frightened 2} on a critical failure).

feat.name: Spectral Dagger
feat.requirements: You have a hand free and aren't already wielding a {@i spectral dagger}.
entries: By touching the {@item splinter of finality|LOSK} in your neck, you conjure a {@i spectral dagger} into your hand that resembles the splinter wrapped in a crude hilt. This weapon acts like a +1 ghost touch dagger, and each successful {@action Strike|PC1} with it deals 1 additional spirit damage. If the attack is a critical hit, this damage increases to {@damage 1d6}.

If the {@i spectral dagger} ever leaves your hand, it vanishes and you must spend an action to conjure it again. If this occurs as the result of you making a ranged thrown {@action Strike|PC1} with the dagger, you resolve the attack before the weapon vanishes.

You can increase the power of your {@i spectral dagger} with runes like you can other weapons, transferring the rune from a runestone or other weapon by meditating over the rune as a {@trait downtime} activity that takes 1 day.

feat.name: Dread Blade
entries: Your strikes with your conjured dagger impart the chill of the grave. When you successfully {@action Strike|PC1} with your {@i spectral dagger} and damage a foe with the {@condition frightened|PC1} condition, they can't reduce their {@condition frightened|PC1} condition below 1 before the end of your next turn.

feat.name: Soul Bleed
entries: Your blade can rupture an enemy's very soul, draining away its essence to empower you. When you score a critical hit with your {@i spectral dagger}, you deal {@damage 1d6} {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent spirit damage}. If the target wasn't already taking {@condition persistent damage|PC1|persistent spirit damage} when you scored the critical hit, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to the spirit damage dealt by the attack that last until the beginning of your next turn.

feat.name: Soul Well
entries: Your brush your fingers across your {@item splinter of finality|LOSK}, momentarily creating a metaphysical vortex from which mortal spirits struggle to escape. For the next minute, {@trait incorporeal} {@trait undead} treat all squares within 30 feet of you as difficult terrain and living creatures within the same area die from the {@condition dying|PC1} condition at {@condition dying|PC1|dying 5} rather than {@condition dying|PC1|dying 4}. As it comes close to tasting a living soul, the {@item splinter of finality|LOSK} is empowered. If a living creature's {@condition dying|PC1} value increases while within your Soul Well, your {@i spectral dagger} deals one additional weapon die of damage until the end of your next turn.

feat.name: Lethal Edge
feat.trigger: Your {@action Strike|PC1} with your {@i spectral dagger} hits a {@condition frightened|PC1} creature and deals spirit damage.
entries: When the terrified are struck by your spectral weapon, they feel the anguish of every life taken by {@i Silent Lenore}. You apply one of the following effects, which lasts until the end of your next turn.

feat.name: Hungry Blade
feat.requirements: Your previous action was a {@action Strike|PC1} with your {@i spectral dagger} that dealt spirit damage.
entries: Once your {@i spectral dagger} has tasted an enemy's soul, your {@item splinter of finality|LOSK} becomes increasingly relentless in its attempts to claim the soul. Your {@i spectral dagger} gains the effects of a keen property rune that applies only to Strikes against the target of the required {@action Strike|PC1}. This effect lasts for 10 minutes or until that target dies, whichever comes first.

feat.name: Vengeful Remnant
entries: You wreathe yourself in the tatters of all the souls claimed by your blade. Until the start of your next turn, you gain resistance 10 to all damage except force, ghost touch, spirit, and vitality, doubled if the source of the damage is non-magical. If you slay a significant foe not immune to spirit damage with your {@i spectral dagger} while under this effect, its duration increases until the end of your next turn.

feat.name: Instrument of Death
entries: Your {@item splinter of finality|LOSK} has reached the apex of its deathdealing potential. Whenever you critically succeed at an attack roll against an enemy and use {@feat Lethal Edge|LOSK}, add the following effects to the list you can choose from.

items: The target is cursed and can't benefit from circumstance or status bonuses. This is a {@trait curse} effect.
The target gains weakness 10 to spirit damage.

feat.name: Guillotine Blade
entries: The echoes of the {@item splinter of finality|LOSK}'s original purpose resonate through the artifact. For the next minute, your {@i spectral dagger} gains the benefits of a vorpal rune. When you use Snicker-Snack with your {@i spectral dagger}, the DC of the Fortitude save is 37, your class DC, or your spell DC, whichever is higher.

feat.name: Soul Oubliette
feat.trigger: You reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points with an attack from your {@i spectral dagger}.
feat.requirements: Your {@item splinter of finality|LOSK} doesn't contain a trapped soul.
entries: Your mortal strike wrenches the soul from your victim's body and imprisons it in your {@item splinter of finality|LOSK}, with the effects of seize soul. The {@item splinter of finality|LOSK} can only hold one soul at a time, but you can release a trapped soul as a free action. If you don't free a soul willingly, it escapes automatically after 24 hours. However, if you touch the {@item splinter of finality|LOSK} to an unbroken final blade while a soul is trapped within, the soul is transferred to the final blade and imprisoned indefinitely.
While your {@item splinter of finality|LOSK} contains a trapped soul, you gain fast healing 15.

feat.name: Wylderheart Dedication
entries: You're primed to face off against threats from the Outer Rifts. You gain the {@feat Additional Lore|PC1} skill feat for {@skill Lore|PC1|Demon Lore}. If you were already trained in {@skill Lore|PC1|Demon Lore}, you also become trained in a {@skill Lore|PC1} skill of your choice. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls in encounters against {@trait fiend||fiends}, and if you tie with a {@trait fiend||fiend's} initiative roll, you go first.

Certain wylderheart feats give you {@trait focus} spells. When you gain your first wylderheart {@trait focus} spell, you become trained in the spell attack modifier and spell DC statistics. Your key spellcasting attribute for the wylderheart {@trait archetype} spells is Wisdom, and they're {@trait primal} spells. You can {@action Refocus|PC1} by celebrating life or spending time in nature.

feat.name: Demon-Hunting Companion
entries: You gain a young animal companion that has been specially trained to help you fight {@trait demon||demons}. You can choose any {@trait common} animal companion, which gains {@ability scent} as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet that can be used only to smell {@trait fiend||fiends}. If the animal companion already has {@ability scent}, it gains a +2 circumstance bonus to {@skill Perception|PC1} when using {@ability scent} against {@trait fiend||fiends}.

feat.name: Wyldsinger
entries: Passion and song are your weapons of choice. You learn either the {@spell menacing lament|LOSK} or {@spell valiant anthem|LOSK} {@trait focus} spell. If you don't already have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point.
special: You can take this feat a second time, gaining the {@trait focus} spell you didn't gain the first time.

feat.name: Blessed Sentinel
entries: You infuse a weapon with the blessing of {@deity Ketephys|LODM} and attack. Make a {@action Strike|PC1}. This {@action Strike|PC1} gains the {@trait holy} trait and deals an additional {@damage 1d4} spirit damage, or {@damage 2d4} spirit damage against {@trait fiend||fiends}. This counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty.

feat.name: Primal Guardian
entries: You grow in power as a guardian of nature. You learn either the {@spell elemental sheath|LOSK} or {@spell vicious howl|LOSK} {@trait focus} spell.
special: You can take this feat a second time, gaining the {@trait focus} spell you didn't gain the first time.

feat.name: Wild Dance
entries: The combination of your passion for both life and the battle against evil makes you graceful and unpredictable. {@action Stride|PC1} up to your Speed. A creature that attempts a reaction triggered by this movement must first attempt a Will save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

Success: The creature is {@condition fascinated|PC1} by you until the end of your next turn.
Failure: The creature is {@condition fascinated|PC1} by you until the end of your next turn, but your movements might be too hard to follow; if the reaction requires an attack roll, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against that attack roll.
Critical Failure: The creature is {@condition fascinated|PC1} by you until the end of your next turn, and it loses its reaction.

feat.name: Fiend Slayer
feat.requirements: Your last action was a successful {@action Strike|PC1} against a {@trait fiend} that dealt damage.
entries: Your attack tears through a {@trait fiend}, possibly sending it back to where it came from. The {@trait fiend} you just struck takes 80 void damage with a basic Fortitude save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. On a critical failure, the target is also {@condition stunned|PC1|stunned 1}. Regardless of the results of the saving throw, the target is then temporarily immune to Fiend Slayer for 24 hours.

feat.name: Sacred Weapon
entries: You're a living weapon honed to destroy {@trait fiend||fiends}. Whenever you critically {@action Strike|PC1} a {@trait fiend}, your attack deals an extra weapon damage die, and the {@trait fiend} is {@condition enfeebled|PC1|enfeebled 2} and {@condition clumsy|PC1|clumsy 2} until the beginning of your next turn.

feat.name: Free Heart
entries: You follow all your passions, unlimited in creativity and zeal. Choose a {@trait common} background that relates to a passion you've pursued; you're trained in the skills and gain the skill feat associated with that background in addition to those in your normal background. As usual for backgrounds, if you would gain the trained proficiency rank for one of these skill from your class at 1st level, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice.

feat.name: Elven Persistence
feat.trigger: You fail a skill check you're at least trained in.
entries: Elves don't give up easily on their pursuits. Instead of the result you received for the triggering skill check, you receive a result of 12 + your proficiency bonus (don't apply any other bonuses, penalties, or modifiers).

feat.name: Lion Blade Dedication
feat.prerequisites: member of the Lion Blades, trained in {@skill Performance|PC1}
entries: Your Lion Blade spy training helps you conceal yourself and your identity. You become trained in your choice of {@skill Deception|PC1} or {@skill Stealth|PC1}; if you were already trained in that skill, you become an expert instead. You also gain the {@feat Additional Lore|PC1} skill feat for {@skill Lore|PC1|Espionage Lore}. If you were already trained in {@skill Lore|PC1|Espionage Lore}, you also become trained in a {@skill Lore|PC1} skill of your choice.
You never take circumstance penalties for attempting to take a disguise of a different ancestry, age, and so on, as long as the disguised form is appropriate for your size.

feat.name: Inspiring Recitation
entries: You quietly speak or recall coded phrases and metaphors whose meanings inspire you to complete your mission. You gain a +1 status bonus to one skill of your choice until the beginning of your next turn. You can {@action Sustain|PC1} this effect for up to 1 minute. If you're an expert in {@skill Performance|PC1}, the bonus increases to +2. If you're a master in {@skill Performance|PC1}, the bonus is +3, and if you're legendary, the bonus is +4.

feat.name: Lost in the Crowd
entries: You've learned how to move as one with crowds and hide among them, vanishing into a busy street in the flicker of an eye. You move at full Speed in crowds and can use cover from crowds to {@action Hide|PC1} and {@action Sneak|PC1}, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to your {@skill Stealth|PC1} checks when in a crowd of at least 10 creatures and a +4 circumstance bonus to your {@skill Stealth|PC1} checks when in a crowd of at least 100 creatures.

feat.name: Crowd Mastery
entries: You use the crowd to your advantage, diverting your foes' attention to potential hidden dangers in the crowd. When determining if your foe is flanked, treat all squares occupied by a crowd as if they were occupied by an ally with a melee reach of 5 feet.

feat.name: Expeditious Advance
feat.requirements: You're unarmored or wearing light armor.
entries: You advance and retreat quickly. You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed.

feat.name: Interposing Crowd
entries: Your enemies can't stop you when there's a host of people between you. Your {@trait movement} actions don't trigger reactions as long as you remain in a crowd for the entire duration of the action.

feat.name: Lion's Magic
entries: Many Lion Blades enhance their words with a bit of magic. You can cast a 4th-rank suggestion as an occult innate spell once per day. At 12th level, you can also cast a 5th-rank subconscious suggestion once per day.

feat.name: Spy's Countermeasures
feat.trigger: You succeed at a save against a {@trait detection}, {@trait mental}, or {@trait scrying} effect
entries: You've learned how to analyze and fake your responses to the most common magic used against spies. You can attempt to identify the effect via {@action Identify Magic|PC1} using the magical tradition skill of the effect or {@skill Lore|PC1|Espionage Lore}, even if you didn't notice the spell being cast.

If you successfully identify the triggering effect, and it would normally fail or have no effect, you can make the caster of the triggering effect think the effect or spell succeeded. If they would obtain a result, such as receive a piece of information, you decide what that result is. If the effect would influence you to take certain actions, you can make it appear as if you were affected and attempt to play along; if the effect normally establishes a mental link, it functions normally, but you can disregard any commands you receive through the link.

feat.name: Flickering Twirl
entries: You use your movements and disguises to make yourself a flickering blur. You gain {@condition concealed|PC1|concealment} until the beginning of your next turn. As usual for {@condition concealed|PC1|concealment} involving an obvious visual manifestation, you can't use this {@condition concealed|PC1|concealment} to {@action Hide|PC1}.

feat.name: Slowing Strike
feat.trigger: Your {@action Strike|PC1} hits an {@condition off-guard|PC1} creature and deals damage.
entries: You wound your enemy so they can't move nimbly. The target must attempt a Fortitude save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

Success: The creature takes a −10-foot status penalty to its Speeds until the beginning of your next turn.
Failure: As success, but the penalty lasts for 1 minute.

feat.name: Stunning Surprise
feat.requirements: You must be {@condition undetected|PC1} by the target creature.
entries: You quickly move in to bring your foe down with a single blow. You move up to your Speed then make a melee {@action Strike|PC1}. If you hit and deal damage, your foe must attempt a Fortitude save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Regardless of the save outcome, the creature then becomes immune to your Stunning Surprise for 24 hours.

Success: The creature is {@condition stunned|PC1|stunned 1} and can't use reactions until its next turn.
Failure: The creature is {@condition stunned|PC1|stunned 3} and can't use reactions until its next turn.
Critical Failure: The creature falls {@condition unconscious|PC1} for 1 minute.

feat.name: Ulfen Guard Dedication
feat.prerequisites: member of the Ulfen Guard, trained in {@skill Athletics|PC1} and {@skill Intimidation|PC1}
feat.access: At least one of your parents is Ulfen.
entries: Central to your Ulfen Guard training is the ability to protect an ally. You gain the {@feat Additional Lore|PC1} skill feat for {@skill Lore|PC1|Warfare Lore}. If you were already trained in {@skill Lore|PC1|Warfare Lore}, you also become trained in a {@skill Lore|PC1} skill of your choice. You gain the Designate Ally action.

It's anathema for you to abandon your designated ally or allow your designated ally to die when you can prevent it. If you violate this anathema, you lose the ability to Designate Ally and any feats that use this ability until you spend 1 day of downtime reaffirming your dedication to your allies.

entries.name: Designate Ally
entries: Choose an ally you can see, who becomes your designated ally. For the next minute, whenever your designated ally is adjacent to you and you're conscious, they gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC and Reflex saving throws. You can have only one designated ally at a time, and if you designate a new ally, the previous ally loses any benefits.

feat.name: Defender's Grit
entries: You can't protect anyone if you're dead. You gain the {@feat Diehard|PC1} {@trait general} feat. If you start your turn adjacent to your designated ally, you gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to half your level that lasts until the beginning of your next turn.

feat.name: Guard's Fury
feat.prerequisites: {@feat Ulfen Guard Dedication|LOSK}, you can't already use the {@action Rage|PC2} action
entries: Some Ulfen Guards tap into a well of fury to protect their charges. You can use the {@action Rage|PC2} action. While raging, you take a −1 penalty to AC. If you're adjacent to your designated ally while raging, increase the additional damage from {@action Rage|PC2} from 2 to 4.

feat.name: Guarded Mind
feat.trigger: You fail a saving throw against an effect that has the {@trait mental} trait.
entries: When your enemies try to turn your mind against you, thoughts of your anathema bolster you. You can reroll the triggering saving throw with a +2 circumstance bonus, but you must use the new result, even if it's worse.

feat.name: Wounded Party
feat.trigger: You or your designated ally takes damage, and you're capable of entering a {@action Rage|PC2}.
entries: Harm to either you or your allies awakens your fury. You {@action Rage|PC2}.

feat.name: Tight Follower
feat.trigger: Your designated ally moves and ends that movement more than 10 feet from you.
entries: You keep up as a protector. {@action Stride|PC1} up to your Speed closer to your designated ally. Your movement must end within 10 feet of your designated ally.

feat.name: Protective Strike
feat.trigger: A creature moves adjacent to or attempts a melee {@action Strike|PC1} against your designated ally.
entries: You keep harm at bay. Make a melee {@action Strike|PC1} against the triggering creature. On a critical success, you interrupt the triggering action.
